item.title: Bahamas island quietly sells $18 million villas, with most land set to remain undeveloped
item.description: The owners of Highbourne Cay rejected a luxury brand's resort proposal, betting that scarcity is worth more than density.

item.title: AI writing debate echoes ancient Greek controversy from 2,700 years ago
